items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Frances White looked after me when I was a little bitty boy. [INTERVIEWEE] She says so.

ctx.x: Her part of Georgia. But her mother died when she was childbirth, and her grandmother taken her and brought her to Florida baby when she was in the home, you see, when she was raised there, but she wasn't right there. Do you remember her name before she married? Who? She's a White. She's a White. She's a White. She was a White.
Fantastic. When I was a little boy, we had a maid named White, you see, and I'm from around Micah, only 30 miles, isn't I? Might be a cousin of your mama's or something. Could be.
But anyway, she was a White before she met my father.
